ticket.notes: Three-leg value accumulator ticket constructed under Model 4.0 (roys_betting_engine_BTS_O2-5_win) and selection_process.md (Section 4 Step 3: Hybrid 3-Leg Architecture Archetype A). Features FK Napredak Kruševac to Win (@ 1.44, 81.0% Model Prob, Dominance Ratio 5.04, +11.6pp Value Edge, EV +0.166), Técnico Universitario vs Manta FC Over 1.5 Goals (@ 1.31, 82.5% Model Prob, DCI 0.593, +6.2pp Value Edge, EV +0.081), and FC Fratria vs FC Sportist Svoge Over 1.5 Goals (@ 1.23, 85.2% Model Prob, +3.9pp Value Edge, EV +0.048). Combined odds: 2.32 vs compound probability 56.9% (break-even 43.1%, cumulative value edge +13.8pp, ticket EV +0.320).

selections.comment: Main Ticket Leg 1. Dominant Home Winner selection under Model 4.0 Section 3.5. Napredak (9th) at Stadion Mladost hosts dead-last 16th-place FK Bor 1919. Bor has collapsed on the road, losing 6 of 8 away fixtures and conceding 17 goals (2.13 GA/G) while scoring only 3 (0.38 GF/G). Dominance ratio reaches an elite 5.04 (Gate 1 Pass >= 2.20). Draw probability is heavily suppressed at 13.5% (Gate 4 Pass <= 22.0%). Both clubs are senior first-teams (Reserve Squad Restriction Passed). Priced at 1.44, the selection captures a strong +11.6pp value edge and +0.166 EV.
selections.notes: Serbian Prva Liga Round 17. Bor 1919 holds a league-worst -23 goal difference.

warnings.evidence: Bor 1919 averages 0.38 GF/G away from home while conceding 2.13 GA/G. Properly channeled into Home Win.
warnings.review_notes: Napredak secured a dominant 2-0 home victory with a clean sheet. Bor 1919's severe away offensive anemia was fully evident, generating zero goals.

warnings.review_notes: Bor 1919 failed to score (2-0 final score). The warning that scoring would be entirely one-sided and that BTTS Yes was unviable was confirmed.

selections.comment: Main Ticket Leg 2. High-Safety Over 1.5 Anchor under Model 4.0 Section 3.1 Tier 1 Corridor. Ecuador Serie A is designated TIER_1 for Over 1.5 in league_baselines.json. Manta FC suffers from acute road defensive leakage, conceding 34 goals in 17 away matches (2.00 GA/G). Técnico at Estadio Bellavista scores and concedes 1.29 GA/G at altitude. DCI is 0.593, ensuring bilateral goal momentum. Over 1.5 has hit in 85.3% of combined venue matches, capturing +6.2pp edge at 1.31 odds.

selections.comment: Main Ticket Leg 3. High-Floor Safety Anchor. FC Fratria at Spartak Stadium in Varna has scored 10 goals in 7 matches (1.43 GF/G), while relegation-threatened Sportist Svoge concedes regularly on the road (7 GA in 6 away MP). With 85.2% model probability and available odds of 1.23, Over 1.5 avoids 1X2 binary draw traps while rounding off the 3-leg hybrid accumulator to combined odds of 2.32.
selections.notes: Bulgarian Vtora Liga Round 15 clash. Sportist Svoge has won only 1 away match this season.

warnings.evidence: Total lambda is regressed at 2.15 goals. Over 1.5 clears with high probability without requiring both teams to score.
warnings.review_notes: Over 1.5 comfortably hit in an explosive 6-2 goalfest. Fratria completely dismantled Sportist Svoge's porous road defense.

warnings.review_notes: Match finished 2-1 (3 goals), successfully clearing Over 1.5. Delfin managed 1 goal while conceding 2, consistent with the viability of Over 1.5 despite low baseline away scoring.
